strategies.name: Sector momentum rotation
strategies.desc: Overweight the sectors that have outperformed over the past 6 months and underweight (short) the laggards, rebalancing monthly.

signal.label: Long Consumer & Telecom (basket), IT (basket) | Short Energy & Utilities (basket), Materials (basket)

notes: Cumulative return over the past 126 trading days (≈ 6 months, Eq. 361). Long the top 2, short the bottom 2, rebalanced monthly.

strategies.name: Sector momentum rotation with MA filter
strategies.desc: Sector momentum, but only buy winners that are in an uptrend (above the 150-day average) and only short losers that are in a downtrend.

notes: Sector momentum with a trend filter: a top-ranked sector is bought only if its price is above its 150-day moving average, and a bottom-ranked sector is shorted only if it is below it (Eq. 362). Filtered-out slots stay in cash.

strategies.desc: Long-only sector rotation that switches entirely to gold/cash when the broad market is below its 200-day average.

strategies.name: Alpha rotation
strategies.desc: Rank sectors by Jensen's alpha versus the market (return left over after market beta) instead of raw return, and rotate into the highest-alpha ones.
strategies.adapted_note: Single-factor (market) alpha instead of Fama-French 3-factor alpha.

signal.label: Long Industrials & Infra (basket), Materials (basket) | Short Energy & Utilities (basket), Staples & Health (basket)

notes: Jensen's alpha = intercept of a 1-year daily regression of each sector's return on the NIFTY 50 (Eq. 364; the book also uses SMB/HML, which are not published for India). Long the highest-alpha sectors, short the lowest.

8 assets: Auto (basket), Consumer & Telecom (basket), Energy & Utilities (basket), Financials (basket), Industrials & Infra (basket), IT (basket), Materials (basket), Staples & Health (basket). 10 bps one-way cost. Dashed line = NIFTY 50 buy-and-hold.

strategies.name: R-squared
strategies.desc: Prefer sectors whose returns are NOT explained by common factors (low R²) and have high alpha; avoid high-R², low-alpha ones.
strategies.adapted_note: Uses market + constructed momentum factor (Fama-French factors are not available for India).

signal.label: Long Energy & Utilities (basket), IT (basket) | Short Auto (basket), Financials (basket)

tables.title: Alpha and R² (latest 1-year regression on market + momentum factors)

notes: Each month sectors are regressed (252 days) on two factors: the market index and a momentum factor built from the constituents' own 12-1m long/short portfolio (Eq. 365 uses MKT, SMB, HML, MOM; only these two are available for India). Long the highest-alpha sectors within the lowest-R² tercile (high 'selectivity'), short the lowest-alpha sectors within the highest-R² tercile.

strategies.name: Mean-reversion
strategies.desc: Buy the sectors that closed near the bottom of yesterday's range and short those that closed near the top, expecting a snap-back.

signal.label: Long Auto (basket), Financials (basket) | Short Industrials & Infra (basket), IT (basket)

notes: Internal Bar Strength IBS = (Close − Low)/(High − Low) (Eq. 370). Each day buy the 2 sectors with the lowest IBS (closed near their low) and short the 2 with the highest, holding one day. Daily turnover is very high, so costs matter: compare 'Sharpe' with 'Sharpe (gross)'.

8 assets: Auto (basket), Consumer & Telecom (basket), Energy & Utilities (basket), Financials (basket), Industrials & Infra (basket), IT (basket), Materials (basket), Staples & Health (basket). 10 bps one-way cost. Dashed line = NIFTY 50 buy-and-hold.

strategies.name: Multi-asset trend following
strategies.desc: A long-only portfolio of assets in an uptrend (equity indexes, gold, silver, Nasdaq-100) weighted by trend strength over variance; cash when nothing trends.

notes: Only assets with a positive 126-day return AND price above their 150-day moving average are held; weights ∝ Rᶜᵘᵐ/σ² (Eq. 373). If nothing qualifies, the portfolio sits in cash (earning 6.5%). Long-only, rebalanced monthly.
6 assets: NIFTY 50, Nifty Next 50, Nifty Bank, Gold ETF (GOLDBEES), Silver ETF (SILVERBEES), Nasdaq-100 ETF (MON100). 10 bps one-way cost. Dashed line = NIFTY 50 buy-and-hold.
